header.messageTitle: Cash deposit instructions for softwood lumber from Canada (A-122-857)

messages.text:
1. Commerce has published in the Federal Register (88 FR 50106) on 08/01/2023 the final results of its administrative review of certain producers and/or exporters subject to the antidumping duty order on softwood lumber from Canada for the period 01/01/2021 through 12/31/2021.

2. As a result of Commerce's review, the cash deposit rates have been revised for certain companies. Ref:  Message 1337405, dated 12/03/2021

1.  Commerce has amended the final results of its administrative review of the countervailing duty order on certain softwood lumber products from Canada for the period 01/01/2019 through 12/31/2019.
